assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness in the setting of known atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries and nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.
Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) was ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmias or ischemic changes that may be contributing to these symptomatic episodes.
This service is consistent with the diagnosis codes I25.10 and R42 on the claim.
The denial of this service under current coverage guidelines does not reflect the documented clinical criteria for this diagnostic modality.
